sourceCorrespondenceFailure.qualification: Relabel counts are not certified individual animation defects. The exact unchanged-region synthetic counterexample establishes the implementation invariant failure.

frozenEndpoint.verdict: A positive recovery difference is evidence of a switching barrier at stationary geometry, not proof that the alternate pixel drawing is aesthetically wrong. No accumulated spatial regret exists in this greedy one-step objective.

historyCostFailure.qualification: A positive one-frame recovery barrier can retain a higher-spatial-cost drawing at stationary geometry. It is not a visual claim that the static raster is automatically the right artwork.
